$comment: Module roles, declared once (ADR-001 amendments 12, 13). deployOrder orders a stack deploy, bootOrder `dev up all` (absent: not booted by default), primaryService the role's primary service id ({project}-<primaryService> locally, {project}-{environment}-<primaryService> on a server), primaryField the manifest field naming the role's primary module (else the first of the role), launchCompound whether vscode-gen compounds it, tier where its units live on a server (catalogs.tiers). A host adds or overrides a role in its manifest (`catalogs.roles`).
